policy.scope: NFR-CMP-0001: desktop Chrome/Edge/Firefox current stable and previous stable major version. No native mobile apps, no screen-reader matrix.
policy.registration: Every entry must record version, install source, isolated profile dir, executable path and auto-update policy before execution. Entries are filled during Env-W preparation; null fields mean not yet registered.
policy.autoUpdate: Browser auto-update is disabled for the acceptance window (per-browser policy field); the six installs stay frozen while AT-0017 runs.
policy.isolation: Each browser uses its own persistent profile directory under artifacts/m6-acceptance/browser-profiles/<id> (untracked) so evidence cannot leak session state between entries.
policy.axe: axe-core is auxiliary only; keyboard, focus, layout and contrast are judged per NFR-CMP-0001 by Playwright assertions plus manual inspection.
policy.fallback: A combination Playwright cannot drive is executed by the manual procedure in e2e/README.md §Manual fallback and registered with its evidence.
